test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

YEN10 : CWN50 :: USD8 : GIX32 :: GDP12 : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

The alphabets are coded as opposite alphabets + 1.

The numbers are coded as (number ÷ 2) x number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe95212687cc050e77d274db9bd6d1d987f475566c17d83ddce6ff1afcc94187.png] 

The term "YEN10" becomes "CWN50".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/093adfb77cbf201be84a1e21b0764304abea8ba4915ee1317fbec71e0d44816a.png] 

The term "USD8" becomes "GIX32".

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09c9e23688b14ae4db13f5df954dd11a32c317be22a3230727264b100fff1476.png] 

The term "GDP12" becomes "UXL72".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
